t: You're on Ayres Street in Southwark, named after Alice Ayres, a nursemaid. In 1885 she lived above her brother-in-law and sister's oil and paint shop in nearby Union Street, helping care for the family's children. When a fire broke out in the shop, she rescued three of her nieces from the burning building. She then fell from a window and was fatally injured. She is honoured for that bravery, and this street carries her name.
